What we’re all about…

Recreation and Wellbeing (RecWell), an integral part of the educational mission of the University of Massachusetts, the Division of Student Affairs and Campus Life, and the Campus Life and Wellbeing Collaborative (CLAW), provides comprehensive opportunities for recreation and student development. Through exceptional programs, services, and facilities, we reflect the values and interests of the UMass community, actively promoting and encouraging a lifelong commitment to health and wellbeing.
